datasets.name: Zero-To-CAD Qwen3-VL-2B
datasets.description: Vision-language model (based on Qwen3-VL-2B) fine-tuned on the Zero-to-CAD dataset to reconstruct editable parametric CAD programs directly from multi-view images

datasets.name: Zero-to-CAD
datasets.description: Datasets (1M and 100K subsets) of executable CAD construction sequences synthesized via an agentic LLM in a CadQuery environment. No real construction-history data used.

datasets.name: MechaFormer
datasets.description: Transformer-based model that frames kinematic mechanism design as a conditional sequence-generation task, synthesizing four-, six-, and eight-bar linkages that trace specified target paths (AAAI 2026)

datasets.name: GearFormer
datasets.description: Deep generative transformer for mechanical system configuration design, focused on gear-train synthesis. Includes code, weights, and search baselines (MCTS, EDA) accompanying the AAAI 2025 paper.

datasets.name: GearFormer Gear-Train Dataset
datasets.description: Curated dataset of valid gear-train configurations (train / val / test splits) used to train GearFormer for generative mechanical system configuration design

datasets.name: DesignQA
datasets.description: A multimodal benchmark for evaluating LLMs' understanding of engineering documentation

openSource.name: XLB
openSource.description: Differentiable multi-GPU simulations in JAX and NVIDIA's Warp for physics-based machine learning

openSource.name: LBfoam
openSource.description: Scalable simulation of foaming using the Lattice Boltzmann Method based on C++ and MPI
